Discover Gdańsk with a private guide

Gdańsk rewards curiosity. Beyond its merchant houses and waterfront are stories of trade, identity, war and rebuilding. I’m Tomasz Królewski, and I guide visitors in English. On a private walking tour, we can use the city’s streets and details as a starting point for the questions that interest you.

What could we explore?

The historic centre, waterfront and architectural details offer a natural introduction to Gdańsk. If you are especially interested in twentieth-century history, we can discuss connecting your visit with the story of the shipyard and Solidarity. The route is agreed together; this is an invitation to plan your day rather than a fixed list of included stops.

A Gdańsk walking tour for families

Travelling with children? Tell me their ages and what captures their imagination. Questions, clues and small discoveries can make a city walk engaging across generations. We can discuss a suitable pace and the balance between walking, stories and pauses.

Make the day personal

Your first visit to Poland, a family connection or a long-standing interest in history can all be a good place to begin. Send your preferred date, group size, language and interests. I will confirm the proposed route, practical arrangements, availability and price before you decide to book.

A monk-guided walk through Gdańsk

Looking for a playful take on the city? Meet Brother Tomasz, my costumed guide character. This walk combines historical storytelling, legends and humour in the historic streets. Explore the monk-guided tour on GetYourGuide ↗ for its current programme and booking details.

Let’s start with a hello.

Write directly to me at oczymmarzysz@icloud.com. Your route, arrangements and price will be confirmed before booking.
